title: Kausa Mwachindalo and Anor v Mathews Musona and Ors (APPEAL NO. 1/2021) [2024] ZMSC 1 (20 March 2024)
case_name: Kausa Mwachindalo and Anor v Mathews Musona and Ors
outcome_detail: Majority (Musonda DCJ, Wood JS) dismissed the appeal — the Court of Appeal's decision that the Bundabunda Soli Shamifwi chieftaincy should rotate to the Kashimbi royal family (and in particular to David Musona) is upheld; the clan must draw up a documented family tree and rotational succession plan among the Mulonga, Tubi-Kalifu and Kashimbi royal families; each party bears own costs. Malila CJ delivered a dissenting opinion (would have allowed the appeal — joint-report cannot supersede matrilineal custom of Soli people).
key_statutes: Supreme Court Rules, Chapter 25, Rules 58 and 68
dissent_summary: Malila CJ: customary practice cannot be changed by agreement among a small number of parties contained in a joint report; matrilineal lineage requirement of the Soli people stands.
